name: Glyphic Letter
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, adventurer. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Khelden, our local mage trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
narrative.objectives: Read the Glyphic Letter and speak to Khelden Bremen inside Northshire Abbey.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Haha, I knew my note would not dissuade you from your path. So, you're prepared then, are you? Prepared to accept your fate? Prepared to challenge the gods and any other forces that stand before you in the pursuit of knowledge and power?

I will not lie, adventurer, you will be feared as much as respected. But also know this, I will be here for you when you need training. Simply seek me out as you grow more powerful.
narrative.requestItemsText: Hello, adventurer. I am Khelden. Is there something I can do for you?

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 1 to 2, 250 XP in all.
